summary: Preserved candidate PR 1887's valid acc_additive_penalties correction and fixed the independently reproduced DFLASH/DSPARK decode lifecycle gap by cumulating output tokens in DFlashDraftInputV2.prepare_for_decode. Twelve existing DFLASH logits and scheduler bookkeeping ownership tests passed.
On gfx950, fp32 additive penalties plus logit bias broadcast across two rows and four verify positions into fp16 with zero finite error versus an explicit CPU reference and preserved -inf masks.
